terminal.renderer: terminal-only capsule-local xterm.js Runtime PTY terminal
terminal.input: keyboard, paste, mouse, and resize events -> Runtime-owned PTY stream
terminal.pty: Runtime-owned PTY; xterm sends input bytes and renders PTY output without direct host process authority
terminal.xterm: capsule-local @xterm/xterm renderer autostarted over the Runtime-owned start/events/input/resize/close stream contract
terminal.entrypoint: the same home-cli binary runs inside the Runtime PTY and through `elastos home` over local Home state

commands.name: home
commands.description: Show Home status, the active view, Inbox, apps, and services.

commands.name: inbox
commands.description: Show Inbox notifications and requests that need attention.

commands.name: people
commands.description: Show your profile, contacts, pending requests, discovery, and People actions.

commands.name: apps
commands.description: List apps available in Home. Terminal apps open here; desktop apps are clearly marked.

commands.name: system
commands.description: Show Home view, update, profile, and device status. Technical details stay under debug topics.

commands.name: mywebsite
commands.description: Advanced command for MyWebSite status, staging a local directory, starting a local preview, publishing a temporary public URL, or explicitly opening the preview in a browser.

commands.name: wallet
commands.description: Show Wallet accounts and requests that need attention.

commands.name: exits
commands.description: Show Browser Exit options from this device and People.

commands.name: invoke
commands.description: List available app actions or run one. Actions that need approval remain blocked until you approve them.

commands.name: debug
commands.description: Debug command for diagnostics hidden from the default Home CLI product surface. Debug rows are declared capability descriptors, not grants.

commands.name: refresh
commands.description: Refresh Home status and available actions.

commands.name: signout
commands.description: End the current browser Home session. In a native terminal, use exit instead.

commands.name: exit
commands.description: Exit Home CLI. In the browser, q or Esc returns to the Desktop.

controls.description: select the previous or next visible item
wheel selects items; tab-row clicks switch sections
